dea.description: Figma desktop app (its MCP server): read frames, layer structure, variables, styles and screenshots from a Figma link or the current selection
dea.setup: Open the Figma desktop app and turn on its MCP server (Figma calls it the desktop or Dev Mode MCP server).

dea.description: A real browser for checking pages: screenshots and accessibility snapshots at any screen size, console and network
dea.setup: Nothing to install: the first use downloads it with npx. Opening pages and clicking ask you first.

dea.description: GitHub: read repositories, files, issues and pull requests; anything that changes GitHub asks first
dea.setup: Create a GitHub token, add DEA_MCP_GITHUB_TOKEN=... to .env, then restart the window.

dea.description: Supabase, read-only, for one project: tables, migrations, logs, advisors and docs
dea.setup: Add DEA_MCP_SUPABASE_TOKEN and DEA_MCP_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF to .env, then restart the window. It runs read-only.
